message:
The other day, we decided to do a little family drill to check our emergency plans and go-bags. Instead of feeling like a chore, we turned it into a cozy event. We gathered around the living room, sipping hot cocoa while we went through our supplies and talked about our plans. It felt nice to check in with each other and remind ourselves what we’d do in different situations, all while sharing some laughs. 

Sometimes, preparedness can feel daunting, but it’s really just about creating a sense of comfort and security together. How do you turn your readiness moments into something enjoyable?
